strings.name: Mohamed Salah
strings.summary: Salah began at Al-Mokawloon and developed through Basel, Chelsea and Italian football into an international winger. His speed, left-footed finishing and consistent output helped Liverpool win the Champions League and two Premier League titles, making him an influential athlete in Africa and the Arab world. In 2026 he ended nine years at Liverpool and signed a two-year Trabzonspor contract while continuing his Egypt career.
